description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of languages used in the OpenAssistant Conversations dataset. The chart contains seven slices, representing different languages. The largest slice, labeled “English,” is a dark blue and occupies approximately 42.8% of the chart. “Spanish” is the next largest, colored a lighter blue and representing 31.4%. Following this is “Russian” at 5.7%, “German” at 3.6%, “French” at 2.9%, “Chinese” at 1.9%, and “Portuguese (Brazil)” and “Thai” combined as “Other” at 5.8%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. A legend is present, listing each language alongside its corresponding color. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
